Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting vaccinating pregnant women and children with mercury-containing vaccines.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the use of mercurycontaining vaccines; andadding a new section to chapter 70.95M RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.95M RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Beginning July 1, 2006, a person who is known to be pregnant orwho is under three years of age shall not be vaccinated with a mercurycontaining vaccine or injected with a mercurycontaining product thatcontains more than 0.5 micrograms of mercury per 0.5 milliliter dose. (2) Notwithstanding subsection (1) of this section, an influenzavaccine may contain up to 1.0 micrograms of mercury per 0.5 milliliterdose.
